suggested_fix: No fix needed. The function finds the entry under the table spinlock, matching on both handle and resource type, so it cannot unlink a different resource that shares the handle. It unlinks with hlist_del_init_rcu, then calls synchronize_rcu() so that RCU readers are finished before it drops the reference. Finally it waits for the completion so that the last reference holder is done before the caller frees the object.
